subject: dplyr:: filter and subset differ when using min()

messages.author: a9c5da7cbde2173d
messages.subject: dplyr:: filter and subset differ when using min()
parts:
Hi,

I loved plyr so I'm experimenting with dplyr, and may be doing something wrong, but filter() and subset() give different results when using min() in the condition.  Using base::min() gives the same results as subset().  filter() with max() seems to work as expected.

Here is a tiny example run under RStudio with R 3.1.0 and dplyr_0.1.3. No other packages were loaded.  

> df <- data.frame(x=-1:5)
> z <- c(3,4)
> 
> subset(df, x > min(z))
x
4
5
> dplyr::filter(df, x > min(z))
x
1
2
3
4
5
> dplyr::filter(df, x > base::min(z))
x
4
5
> dplyr::filter(df, x > max(z))
x
5
>
